module purpose: neorv32_cpu_control is a CPU control unit: it takes instructions from frontend_i into its execute engine, decodes them into an immediate and a registered control word driven on ctrl_o, computes branch decisions and the next PC, holds the machine, debug and trigger CSRs (written from csr.wdata, read back on csr_rdata_o), buffers exceptions and interrupts and turns them into a prioritized trap cause, performs trap entry and return with privilege switching, checks instruction legality and CSR access rights, and manages debug mode, a hardware trigger, sleep and counter control.

use-case flows.value: instruction dispatch: fetched instruction word, compressed flag and fetch fault taken from frontend_i, and the PC advanced
decode and execute: immediate and registered datapath control word (ALU, LSU, write-back, CSR strobes) driven on ctrl_o
branch decision, next-PC target and link address
CSR write: write data, address and write enable updating machine, debug and trigger CSRs
CSR value selected by csr.addr returned on csr_rdata_o
pending exceptions and interrupts and the prioritized trap cause
trap entry: trap target PC and state saved in mcause, mepc, mtval, mtinst, privilege and interrupt-enable stack
trap return (mret/dret): return PC, restored privilege and interrupt enable
privilege check: CSR access permission and instruction legality raising the illegal-instruction exception, which blocks CSR writes and reads
debug mode: entry requests, debug-mode state, dcsr and dpc
hardware trigger match of tdata2 against the next PC
counter inhibit and counter events delivered on ctrl_o
multi-cycle wait watchdog that ends a co-processor wait with an illegal-instruction exception
engine state, PC, control word, CSRs, trap and debug state forced to defaults while rstn_i is low
